dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three distinct O-shaped and two C-shaped structures with high-contrast light-grey perimeters. The largest O-shape on the lower-left flank shows a sharp intensity gradient transition to a dark core. Smaller rings on the upper dorsal region exhibit irregular, jagged edge geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the upper longitudinal axis, appearing as solid-tone speckles without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the lateral flank form an obtuse triangle relative to the longitudinal axis of the subject.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-intensity, thin linear artifact or tag forming a visible loop and trailing segment is present on the distal portion of the rear flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: A region of dense, high-frequency white stippling on the anterior dorsal surface provides a unique 'frosted' textural appearance independent of the macro-annuli.
